test_dataframe_query_basic: test DataFrame.query() with simple column comparison expressions like A > 0
test_dataframe_eval_basic: test DataFrame.eval() with arithmetic expressions like A + 1
test_query_with_numexpr_engine: test DataFrame.query() using engine='numexpr' for numeric filtering
test_query_with_pandas_parser: test DataFrame.query() using parser='pandas' for @local variable support
test_query_with_multiindex: test DataFrame.query() filtering on named and unnamed MultiIndex levels
test_query_with_backtick_quoting: test DataFrame.query() using backtick-quoted column names with special characters
test_eval_with_resolvers: test DataFrame.eval() and pd.eval() with custom resolvers dictionaries
test_query_with_local_variables: test DataFrame.query() using @ prefix to reference Python local variables
test_query_with_datetime_columns: test DataFrame.query() filtering on datetime and NaT values
test_query_with_extension_array_dtypes: test DataFrame.query() and eval() with nullable integer and extension array dtypes
